title: Additive & Disclosure Labels (per language)
description: Shape of every data/translations/declarations/<lang>.json file: an object keyed by the disclosure `key` from data/additives.json, so a lookup is O(1) with no join step. A locale may cover fewer keys than the structural file; consumers should fall back to another locale for anything absent.

name.description: Short display label as printed on a menu, e.g. 'mit Farbstoff'.
